title: Cellar and Choir
author: E. M. Fairweather
blurb: Petra Coldharbour, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twelve years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
